data.title: Astronomical society committee
data.transcript: Speaker 1: Callum Breck, treasurer. I still need the receipts for the eyepiece order to close the quarter. Speaker 2: Sorry. I'll send you the receipts tonight. Speaker 1: Thanks. And for the December star party, the school only takes hall bookings until the 15th of November. Speaker 2: I'll book the hall, then. Speaker 1: Good.
